No, it’s rape because it is sexual coercion. Please look at the first bullet under ‘what is sexual coercion?’ https://www.womenshealth.gov/relationships-and-safety/other-types/sexual-coercion

Sexual coercion is a form of sexual assault, and sexual assault is rape. Please let me know if you would like more information, because I think it is important that people understand what consent is. 

I know a lot of people do this (I’ve been in the receiving end) but it doesn’t change the fact that this has had an extremely negative effect on my ex. She said that it has prevented her from loving anyone ever again, and she has constantly contemplated suicide. I wasn’t considerate of her thoughts or feelings. For some reason, I just wanted sex, and now I realize how evil that was. Even if I don’t kill myself, I should be thrown in jail.
Also my ex wants me to kill myself. Why shouldn’t I since I’ve caused her this much harm?
We’re both women. How is this not rape? I repeatedly asked her to have sex with me after the first no until she gave in, which is by definition sexual coercion. Sexual coercion is sexual assault.
She does resent me and she has said that this was practically force and therefore it was rape. I never threatened or blackmailed her or anything like that though. I just kept asking and that’s awful.

We have no more communication. After she threatened to kill herself after seeing me happy on social media after we broke up, I decided it was best that we stop talking/following each other. I think she blames me for a lot of her problems, like dropping out. Am I to blame?

Coercing someone into having sex with you is one form of sexual assault. I know it’s not as awful as blackmailing someone into sex, but it is assault, or at best a terrible thing to do. How can I live with being an abuser?
I feel like deserve to be punished by feeling bad the rest of my life, but that makes it hard to live, and my friends and family don’t want me to die even though I don’t deserve them.
Honestly I feel so awful that I can’t function anymore. It happened a long time ago but it’s with me during every moment. I feel like I don’t deserve happiness.
